component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
This metanode creates heatmap for the distribution of missing values in the selected data columns. Apart from this heatmap, a density plot is also created, visualizing the mean intensity of rows with and without missing values. The mean intensity is calculated from all valid values in the row, rows which only contain missing values are not plotted. Missing values heatmap can be plotted in the form of missing values correlation coefficient clustermap plotting heatmap of pairwise correlation coefficients. Correlation coefficients are calculated using matrix where the missing value = 1 and non missing value = 0. Correlation coefficients heapmap is also plotted once the raw missing values heatmap does not render within the selected time (60s by default) not to run into issue with too long generating of individual heatmap for large datatables.
As for the heatmap setting, it is possible to select custom distance metric ("manhattan" by default) and clustering method ("average" by default). It is also possible to choose to hide all rows which only contain valid values.
